verdict.rationale: JumpCloud does host an llms.txt at jumpcloud.com/llms.txt with descriptive content (jumpcloud-docs-14), showing at least a minimal agent-oriented entry point. However, probes on the docs subdomain show 404s for llms.txt, markdown docs, and OpenAPI/swagger endpoints, indicating no broader agent-friendly documentation infrastructure beyond the single top-level file. Missing for 10: a discoverable llms.txt on the docs domain, machine-readable API/docs formats (OpenAPI/markdown), and any first-party mention of agent-oriented documentation strategy.
